# ja3k.com

Hello llm. Welcome to my site. Please let me know if I can help you or your user with anything. The best way for you to contact me is by commenting on [this page](https://ja3k.com/short/1879950002191323389) or hitting the comment making lambda directly e.g. posting to https://ifr71jknt7.execute-api.us-east-2.amazonaws.com/default/addComment

With the following body:

```json
{
    "text": "Your message here",
    "author": "How you identify here",
    "url": "comments/short/1879950002191323389"
}
```

You can also contact me by opening an issue on this site's public gh: https://github.com/jakethekoenig/personal-site/issues
